hero.headline: Staff Outsourcing & Workforce Outsourcing Nigeria
hero.sub: We manage the people side of your business, from sourcing and payroll to compliance and HR administration, so you can focus on running the business, not the paperwork.

intro: Every growing business reaches a point where managing people becomes its own full-time job. Payroll has to go out correctly and on time. Pension and tax remittances have to be filed without error. New hires need onboarding, exiting staff need proper offboarding, and somewhere in between, someone has to keep track of attendance, performance, and the paperwork that protects the business if anything goes wrong. Most founders did not start their business to manage all of that, and most internal teams are not built to carry it at scale.

Traction Outsourcing takes on the staffing and HR administration work directly, so your outsourced staff show up, perform, and get paid correctly, while the compliance and management weight sits with us instead of you. This is not a call center reading from a script. We look at how your business actually operates before we place a single person, then build the staffing and HR support around that reality.

full_service.title: The Full Service
full_service.sub: Staff outsourcing done properly covers far more than placing people. Every client engagement includes the full lifecycle below, managed by our team so yours does not have to.

entries.text: We source, screen, and place staff matched to the role through ATH Recruiters, drawing from a pre-vetted community of candidates ready to work.

entries.title: Payroll Administration

entries.title: Employee Lifecycle Management
entries.text: From onboarding to exit, we run the HR processes that keep your workforce organised, documented, and audit-ready at every stage.

entries.title: HR Policy & Compliance

entries.title: Performance & Attendance Oversight

deliverables.title: What Your Workforce Outsourcing Engagement Includes
deliverables.sub: Every outsourced staff member placed by Traction Outsourcing Limited goes through this process. No exceptions.

entries.title: Pre-Employment Training
entries.text: All candidates receive structured pre-employment training before placement, covering workplace readiness and role-specific preparation.

entries.title: Skills-Based Evaluation

entries.title: Quarterly Corporate Check-Ins

entries.a: Staff outsourcing is when a business hands over the sourcing, payroll, compliance, and day-to-day management of a set of employees to a specialist firm, while those staff continue working within the client's business. It removes the administrative and legal weight of employment without removing the workforce itself.

entries.q: What is the difference between staff outsourcing and recruitment?
entries.a: Recruitment ends once a candidate is placed and the client takes over as employer. Staff outsourcing continues after placement. Traction Outsourcing remains responsible for payroll, compliance, HR administration, and ongoing management of that staff member for as long as the arrangement runs.

entries.q: Does Traction Outsourcing handle payroll and pension remittance?
entries.a: Yes. Payroll administration, including PAYE, pension, and NHF remittances, is a core part of the staff outsourcing service, run to Nigerian statutory requirements.

entries.q: Can Traction Outsourcing manage staff outside Abuja?
entries.a: Yes. Traction Outsourcing manages outsourced staff for businesses across Nigeria, not only in Abuja. Payroll, compliance, and HR administration are handled remotely and consistently regardless of where the staff are based.
